${ModID}:Star.NAME: Star
${ModID}:Star.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Deal !D! damage. NL When Exhausted, deal !M! damage to a random enemy. NL Exhaust.

${ModID}:DarkBullet.NAME: Dark Bullet

${ModID}:DarkBullet.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Apply ${ModID}:Swoon. NL Deal !D! damage. NL Exhaust.

${ModID}:Wormhole.NAME: Wormhole
